mapper.sql: r.report_id reportId, r.routine_id routineId, r.project_id projectId, case when r.routine_id is null then '项目工作汇报' else coalesce(t.routine_name, '已停用持续工作') end routineName, r.frequency, r.period_start periodStart, r.period_end periodEnd, r.content, r.attachment_urls attachmentUrls, r.submitted_user_id submittedUserId, r.submitted_user_name submittedUserName, r.status, r.reviewed_user_id reviewedUserId, r.reviewed_user_name reviewedUserName, r.review_comment reviewComment, r.reviewed_time reviewedTime, r.create_time createTime
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_work_report (routine_id, project_id, frequency, period_start, period_end, content, attachment_urls, submitted_user_id, submitted_user_name, create_time) values (#{routineId}, #{projectId}, #{frequency}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{content}, #{attachmentUrls}, #{submittedUserId}, #{submittedUserName}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select from biz_project_work_report r left join biz_project_routine t on t.routine_id = r.routine_id where r.project_id = #{projectId} order by case when r.status = 'PENDING' then 0 else 1 end, r.create_time desc, r.report_id desc

select from biz_project_work_report r join (select project_id, routine_id, max(report_id) report_id from biz_project_work_report where submitted_user_id = #{userId} group by project_id, routine_id) latest on latest.report_id = r.report_id left join biz_project_routine t on t.routine_id = r.routine_id
select from biz_project_work_report r left join biz_project_routine t on t.routine_id = r.routine_id where r.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: update biz_project_work_report set status = #{decision}, review_comment = #{comment}, reviewed_user_id = #{reviewedUserId}, reviewed_user_name = #{reviewedUserName}, reviewed_time = sysdate() where report_id = #{reportId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_work_report_notification (report_id, recipient_user_id, create_time) values (#{reportId}, #{recipientUserId}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select n.notification_id notificationId, n.read_time readTime, n.create_time createTime, r.report_id reportId, r.project_id projectId, r.routine_id routineId, p.project_name projectName, case when r.routine_id is null then '项目工作汇报' else coalesce(t.routine_name, '已停用持续工作') end routineName, r.reviewed_user_name reviewerName, r.review_comment reviewComment, r.reviewed_time reviewedTime from biz_project_work_report_notification n join biz_project_work_report r on r.report_id = n.report_id left join biz_project p on p.project_id = r.project_id left join biz_project_routine t on t.routine_id = r.routine_id where n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} and r.submitted_user_id = #{userId} order by (n.read_time is null) desc, n.notification_id desc limit 100
mapper.update: update biz_project_work_report_notification set read_time = sysdate() where recipient_user_id = #{userId} and read_time is null
